route_results.reason: Vacancy creation, withdrawal, filling and skill mix are forward labor-demand states distinct from reported headcount. However, no admitted archive binds listed parent, historical employer or subsidiary, requisition, job family, location, duplicate or repost lineage, open, close, fill and correction clocks, first-public availability, platform coverage and the complete 2019-2023 applicable denominator without current-state or platform survivorship leakage.

Campaign198 already freezes issuer-owned product release, version, migration, patch, deprecation, end-of-support and retirement states and their complete source-admission gate. Selecting an app store, package registry or online-service catalog is a prohibited channel, product-role and source variant.

Campaign209 already governs booking, waybill, pickup, linehaul, delivery, return, claim and settlement, while Campaign222 governs manifest, cargo custody, inspection and customs hold or release. Using customs or bill-of-lading records for the listed customer or supplier rather than an operator is an entity-role and source substitution, not a new shipment mechanism.

Campaign204 explicitly freezes customer connection, meter, delivered quantity, interruption, restoration, bill and arrears states. Recasting the customer as a listed issuer or choosing electricity, gas, water or district energy is a prohibited entity-role, commodity and cohort variant; no complete privacy-safe full-market customer archive is admitted.

Campaign172 already freezes issuer coverage, claim acceptance, denial, recovery and retained-risk states, while Campaign189 freezes insurer claim incidence, paid or incurred loss, severity, settlement and reserve development. Loss-control labels, insured versus insurer role, peril or claim subset cannot reopen either terminal mechanism.

Campaign196 governs inventory item, lot, ownership, custody, warehouse, consignment and disposition state, while Campaign182 governs credit facility, covenant, collateral and liquidity backstop. A warehouse receipt or pledge registry joins the same inventory and collateral states through another instrument and no complete historical receipt-holder, issuer-parent, release, substitution, cancellation and applicable-denominator contract is admitted.

Domain, DNS and transport-certificate issuance, renewal and expiry can describe an online operating footprint distinct from software release or incident outcomes. The workspace nevertheless has no admitted archive binding listed parent, historical owner or operator, domain, subdomain, certificate, service materiality, registration, DNS, issuance, revocation, renewal, expiry, correction, first-observed and first-public clocks with complete 2019-2023 issuer and uncovered-domain denominators. A current website field or current certificate-transparency view cannot be backcast.

decision.reason: No frozen route simultaneously survives mechanism independence and point-in-time source-contract readiness. The priority selection rule therefore stops Campaign275 before formula, direction, source fields, rows or values.
decision.next_safe_work: Campaign276 may freeze a new finite concept-only catalog before targeted inventory. It must not rescue any Campaign275 route through a sibling provider, entity role, jurisdiction, field, metric, window, threshold, direction or incomplete source.
